text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, one more shot? Rice-san, Urara-san, 
get a little closer, please♪ Saying 
cheese!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"#Selfie #AuditionInProgress 
#BeforeTheRiddles 
#DoingOurBestTogether #CheerForUs"—Yup, 
that should do it♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that photo will make a wonderful 
memory too. 
...By the way, I wonder when the audition 
will begin?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It has been quite a while since each team 
was guided to their rooms. 
Could it be that this waiting time is also 
part of the audition?

"—Hum-hum-hum-hum~♪ Beauty Channel~♪ 
Just kidding! Bonjour, it's Beauty 
Anshinzawa!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That voice... Where is it coming from?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it that? The sound is coming from 
that computer over there!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm so thrilled to see so many rough 
diamonds gathering this year too! 
Alright then, let's get right to 
explaining the rules for this audition♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The trial prepared for you this time is a 
"riddle-solving quest"! You'll be taking 
on three riddles to search for this 
hotel's "Church Key"!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The first two riddles are prepared in 
different locations for each team. And 
only the teams that manage to clear both 
of those riddles—

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
—will get to challenge the final riddle in 
the "Special Suite" shown on screen right 
now☆

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The teams that successfully solve all 
three riddles and obtain a "Church Key" 
will propose to the racewear at the church 
as muse candidates!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Give me your very best proposals so you 
can get engaged to my racewear♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, don't forget that the beauty 
you unpolished gems display while solving 
the riddles will also be judged! The time 
limit is sunset today.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
—And so, this year's Beauty Dream Cup Muse 
Audition begins brilliantly☆

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waah, it's finally started! My heart's 
racing~ Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Ah... but where should we even start 
with solving riddles?

text_block_list.name: Hotel Concierge
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, I have a delivery for you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see, so the riddles are being 
distributed to each room like this. 
...Allow me to read it on behalf of our 
team.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Solve the following riddle and obtain the 
item—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"In the corridor high above the heavens, 
10 becomes 1 and 100 becomes 10. Trace the 
peaks of maidens. The zelkova shaken by 
opera, the melody leads to the capital's 
stream."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"The corridor high above the heavens"... 
This must be referring to our first 
destination, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this is just a thought, but could it 
be talking about the observation deck 
attached to this hotel?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
An observation deck! I had no idea there 
was one here. Have you stayed at this 
hotel before, Fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No, but they showed me a floor map when we 
arrived at the hotel. I needed it to 
coordinate with my security team.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, it said, "A 100m-perimeter 
observation corridor at a height of 250m. 
Please enjoy the 360-degree panoramic 
view!" or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, Fine-san, you remembered all of 
that!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it is because you have many 
opportunities to deliver speeches... 
Truly, such wisdom—ah, pardon me. First, 
we should head to the observation deck, 
yes?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's so spacious! And so high up~! Hey, 
hey, I wonder if we can see Tracen Academy 
from here!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
From this angle, looking out the opposite 
window would be best. But let us focus on 
solving the riddle for now, Urara-san.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Right, focus...! Um, "10 becomes 1 and 100 
becomes 10"... Does this mean we're 
supposed to count something?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Count? Like the number of people, or the 
number of buildings?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder? Since this is an audition for 
racewear, I thought it might be a riddle 
related to races. Let's see, the clue was—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"In the corridor high above the heavens, 
10 becomes 1 and 100 becomes 10. Trace the 
peaks of maidens. The zelkova shaken by 
opera, the melody leads to the capital's 
stream."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Setting aside the mystery of the numbers 
for a moment... When you think of races 
and "opera," would that be Hanshin 
Racecourse in Takarazuka City...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see~ I was actually invited to a theater 
there after watching a race once before. 
In that case, what about this 
"zelkova"...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That would be the Grand Zelkova at Tokyo 
Racecourse♪ And lastly, if "the capital's 
stream" refers to Kyoto Racecourse with 
the Yodo River flowing nearby—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Trace the peaks of maidens"—in other 
words, the clue is telling us to trace the 
Triple Tiara: the Oka Sho, the Yushun 
Himba, and the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~!? Does that mean we have to go all 
the way to Hanshin Racecourse right now!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh no... Can we really visit three whole 
racecourses and still make it before the 
time limit...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please calm down, you two. This is a 
"riddle-solving quest," so it is unlikely 
asking us to physically visit the actual 
racecourses.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The key must lie in the remaining riddle: 
"10 becomes 1 and 100 becomes 10"—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wonderful, Ikuno-san♪ That just gave 
Curren a flash of inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, the answer is the spot 
you reach after walking "1.6 laps 
clockwise, 2.4 laps counter-clockwise, and 
2 laps clockwise" around this observation 
deck!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The hint is—the information from the hotel 
map that Fine-san remembered for us♪
